stem: During a two-week TV promotion, Voltmarkt's audio manager asks: "Soundbars were not on deal. How many more soundbars did we sell in those weeks than in normal weeks, next to the promoted TVs?" Which calculation answers this question?

options.text: Sister TVs' units lost against their baselines during the deal
The promoted TVs' units above their baseline during the deal
Soundbars' units above their baselines during the TV deal
Soundbar net revenue / soundbar units in the deal weeks
